body: Rajeev Aggarwal (CFO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "Some bit of a payment is also, let's say, due from Afghanistan. So we expect that payment to get realized in quarter 3" Metric: Afghanistan (ADB) receivable ~INR 250-300 cr. Target: realised in Q3FY26. Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Re-dated to Q4FY26 (Nov-25, acknowledged when asked), 'supposed to come in Q1' (Aug-26), received '>INR200 crores ... in October' 2026 (Nov-26). Three quarters late. Explanation given: ADB taking a portfolio-wide position (prompted)
